stemMarkdown: A student scored 125 marks in an exam and failed by 55 marks. If the pass mark is 30% of the maximum marks, what are the maximum marks?
solutionMarkdown: The pass mark is $125 + 55 = 180$. If the maximum is $M$, then $\dfrac{30}{100} \times M = 180$, so $M = \dfrac{180 \times 100}{30} = 600$.
